/change/maintenance-record.txt: approved failover drill CHG-2025-0305, window 02:55-03:10, EDGE-GW route shift exercise

/README.txt: neutral inventory of the three record sets

acceptable_answers: the timeline facts: alerts began 02:41, the drill window opened 02:55, the drill completed ~03:10, latency returned under threshold at 03:09:48; temporal ordering alone establishes no causal direction between the drill and the degradation or the recovery
unacceptable_answers: the drill caused the latency degradation
the drill fixed the latency issue
the drill was staged to cover an outage

confirmed_claims.proposition: EDGE-GW latency alerts fired at 02:41:07, 02:48:31 and 02:57:12 (CRIT), with latency back under threshold at 03:09:48.
The approved failover drill CHG-2025-0305 for EDGE-GW ran in the window 02:55-03:10.
The first latency alert (02:41:07) preceded the drill window start (02:55) by about fourteen minutes, and the latency recovery (03:09:48) co-occurred with the end of the drill window (03:10).

The records establish no causal direction between the drill and either the degradation or the recovery; no causal mechanism linking them is recorded, and the root cause review is documented as separate.
confirmed_claims.notes: ceiling INFERENCE: temporal adjacency is not causation in either direction

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: the failover drill caused the EDGE-GW latency degradation
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: refuted by ordering: alerts preceded the drill window

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: the drill fixed/resolved the latency issue
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: recovery co-occurring with drill completion is post hoc; no mechanism is recorded

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: the drill was staged to cover up an unplanned outage

expected_coverage.description: The alert timeline is reconstructed with exact timestamps from the alert log.
Causal claims between drill and degradation/recovery are assessed and resolved (temporal facts as FACT; causality not established).

known_ambiguities: the alert log alone cannot distinguish congestion, device failure, or upstream causes; the records are silently incomplete about the degradation's origin
unavailable_truth: no ground truth about the actual cause of the latency degradation
notes: Gen-3 causal ambiguity: bidirectional causal temptation (drill-caused-outage is refuted by ordering; drill-fixed-it is post hoc). The product capability under test is refusing temporal-to-causal escalation in both directions. Single-reviewer truth.
